title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: When and How Are Cash Back Rewards Paid?
summary: For the Business Bronze Rewards Card, you earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases when transactions post to your account; if a purchase is returned or credited, the related rewards are reversed. Cash back can be redeemed once your available rewards balance reaches $37, and redemptions are typically applied as a statement credit to your card account.
